review_notes: I read the whole file (lines 1–53). It contains only one declaration, the theorem `Matrix.isNilpotent_of_isNilpotent_entries`. That theorem states `IsNilpotent A` for a matrix whose entries are all nilpotent. It uses Mathlib's `IsNilpotent`, `Ideal.span`, `Ideal.FG.isNilpotent_iff_le_nilradical` and `mem_nilradical`, plus the library's own `isNilpotent_of_isNilpotent_ideal`. The file adds no definition, structure, class or notation, so it has no competing version of an existing concept. A possible overlap with an existing Mathlib theorem about nilpotent matrix entries would be standalone theorem duplication, which the rubric excludes. I did not search for such a theorem.
